newLayers.name: Standalone Worker and Web UI
newLayers.description: Support classes for the standalone Worker: launching driver processes (DriverRunner, DriverWrapper), building commands, command line arguments, the worker watcher, metrics source and the worker web UI pages.

newLayers.name: History Server and Event Logs
newLayers.description: Reading and writing event log files (single file and rolling), compacting them with event filters, the application cache and the application history provider interface used by the history server.

appendDesc.RPC and Security: Also covers the Hadoop file system and HBase delegation token providers.

tour.title: Event log files: writers, readers and compaction
tour.description: EventLogFileWriters creates the writer for a single file or a rolling set of files, and EventLogFileReaders opens either form again. EventLogFileCompactor rewrites old rolling files using EventFilter and BasicEventFilterBuilder to drop events that are no longer needed, such as those of finished jobs.
